title: Stop emitting DisplacementMapFilter as invalid SWF FilterID=8 (corrupts filter list)
description: DONE (task 1239). DisplacementMapFilter was VESTIGIAL: present in the FlashFilter union + SWF encoder (FilterID=8) but unreachable from the authoring model/UI (no FiltersPanel entry, no FLA-import decoder, no tween interpolation). FilterID=8 is invalid in the Flash 8 SWF FILTERLIST (ids 0..7 only); Ruffle's swf crate rejects it as 'Invalid filter type' and decodes filters=None for the WHOLE PlaceObject3, dropping every filter on that instance. FIX (packages/swf/src/filters.ts): added isSwfEncodableFilter()/encodableFilters(); writeFilterList now skips any non-0..7 filter (dev console.warn). Only encodable filters count toward FilterCount, the HasFilterList flag (both encodePlaceObject3WithFilters + …WithBlendMode), and PO2-vs-PO3 routing (hasEnabledFilters). Removed the vestigial writeDisplacementMapFilter/hexToRGBA encode path. REGRESSION TEST: __tests__/displacement-filter.test.ts rewritten — proves a lone displacement emits no FILTERLIST, and displacement+blur (either order, and via blend-mode path) emits count=1/FilterID=1 with the blur intact. RESULTS: pnpm --filter './packages/**' build OK (typecheck clean); @flash/swf 1443/1443 pass; @flash/authoring-ui 653/653 pass; @flash/core 5295 pass / 2 fail in 3 files — all ENOENT for fixtures/flash8-empty.fla which is ABSENT in main too (large binary fixture not in repo), pre-existing + unrelated to this change. NOTE: the Rust swf-crate decode (tools/swf-dump) could not be run here — it path-depends on ../../ruffle/swf and the ruffle clone is not present in this environment; verification is the established byte-level structural decode idiom used across filters.test.ts/filterlist.test.ts. Updated docs/08-filters-blend-modes.md.
